pen-river-area.alt: Left: a rectangular pen against a river, split by a middle fence; the three fences perpendicular to the river have length x, the far side has length y, and 3x + y = 600 feet. Right: the graph of A(x) = x(600 - 3x) for 0 ≤ x ≤ 200, zero at both ends, highest at (100, 30000).

pen-river-diagram.alt: A rectangular pen against a straight river, divided in two by a middle fence parallel to the ends. The two ends and the divider each have length x; the side opposite the river has length y. No fence along the river. Total fence: 600 feet.
